info.name: Archive metadata
info.summary: Read-only archival (MDTO) metadata from the storage layer in the Files sidebar
info.description:
Shows archival metadata of a file in a read-only "Archive" tab in the Files sidebar.
The values come from the storage layer: S3 Object Lock retention and legal hold, and S3 object metadata or tags. An administrator can also set values with an occ command. Every value states where it came from and when it was read.
Users cannot change the values. The app stores them as Nextcloud file metadata that core refuses to edit over WebDAV, and it offers no write endpoint.
Fields follow MDTO, the Dutch metadata standard for durable government information: classificatie, bewaartermijn, waardering, informatiecategorie, zorgdrager and identificatie.
info.author: Conduction B.V.
